content.bridge_context: Categorizing changes based on whether a new substance is formed.

units.title: Physical Changes
units.explanation: No new substance is formed. Changes in shape, size, or state. Example: Melting ice, Tearing paper.
units.dual_language_instruction: Is breaking a pencil a physical change? / क्या पेंसिल तोड़ना एक भौतिक परिवर्तन है?

units.title: Chemical Changes
units.explanation: A new substance is formed. Usually irreversible. Example: Burning wood, Rusting iron.
units.dual_language_instruction: What happens when you burn paper? / कागज जलाने पर क्या होता है?
